title: 🔥 Introducing: Barbecue Steak Bites by Pixie! 🔥
paragraphs: 🔥 Introducing: Barbecue Steak Bites by Pixie! 🔥
Who said you can’t invent your own recipe at 50? 😆 Behold, my newest masterpiece: Barbecue Steak Bites by Pixie! (Yes, I named it—branding matters! 🤣)
It’s a crispy, saucy, buttery, smoky, peppery, and heavenly dish that will make you say, “Hallelujah, lami kaayo!”
✨ The Divine Inspiration Behind This Dish

I was staring at a pack of drumsticks and thought, “Lord, what magic can I do with this?” Then boom—a revelation! 🤯 Crispy-fried drumstick steak bites smothered in barbecue sauce with a touch of egg, butter, and black pepper!

When my family tasted it, they said:
💛 “Pa, this is amazing! Lami kaayo, murag restaurant level!”
And just like that… I felt like a 5-star chef in Heaven’s kitchen.

Honestly, it reminded me of Psalm 34:8 –
"Taste and see that the Lord is good!"
Because good food + family love = God’s blessings in edible form!
🔥 The Sacred Recipe – Barbecue Steak Bites by Pixie 🔥

🔸 Ingredients:
🍗 1 kg chicken drumsticks (blessed & ready)
🍳 1 egg (binding everything like faith)
🧈 2 tbsp butter (for that divine richness)
🫙 ½ cup barbecue sauce (sauce of grace)
🧂 1 pack crispy fry breading (the crispy anointing)
🌶️ 1 tsp black pepper (for that kick)
🔥 Cooking oil (for the baptism of frying)

🔹 Instructions:
1️⃣ Pray first! (Holy Spirit, take over the frying pan!)
2️⃣ Coat drumsticks in egg + crispy fry + black pepper mix.
3️⃣ Deep fry until golden and crispy like faith under fire.
4️⃣ Melt butter in a separate pan, then pour in barbecue sauce.
5️⃣ Toss the crispy chicken in the sauce until fully baptized.
6️⃣ Serve hot and watch your family worship the goodness of food!

🔥 Life is like a new recipe—you just need faith, patience, and a little butter.
🔥 Cooking is proof that even late bloomers can shine!
🔥 Most importantly, good food brings people together, just like God’s love!
Kinsa ganahan mo-try ani? Or do you have a crazy food invention of your own? Let’s celebrate food and faith! 😆🙌
